description: Build everything TradingView's create_alert(webhook, message, expiration, resolution) needs, in one call: fuses `command` (the message) and `hooks` (the webhook URL for hook_id), and fills in the expiration (default 1 year out -- TradingView itself defaults to only 30 days, which silently stops the alert) and resolution (default "1") TradingView also needs. The order is validated against the exchange(s) hook_id is actually linked to and rejected if it could never fire there. Returns warnings you should read, including never putting the hook's key in the message field and a fan-out warning when the hook links more than one exchange. Dry-run by default like `command`; set live:true to build a command that trades for real once the alert fires. Requires your Autoview account token.

action.description: manage EXISTING orders/positions on symbol instead of placing a new one: cancel = cancel open orders, close = close open positions, flat = cancel every order AND close every position (Tradovate only). When set, side (if given) is an optional buy/sell filter (not applicable to flat), and quantity/type/price/trigger/brackets/unit are ignored.

exchange.description: optional — any exchange id known to Autoview (see `catalog`); a bracket is refused if that exchange lists its params as unsupported. Must be one of the exchanges hook_id is linked to (otherwise the alert is rejected); omit to validate against every exchange the hook is linked to

expiration.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for TradingView's alert expiration; defaults to 1 year from now

hook_id.description: the hook whose URL becomes the alert's webhook (see the `hooks` tool)

live.description: false (default) = build a dry-run preview command (appends d=1); true = build a command that places a real order when the alert fires

price.description: absolute limit price; required for an explicit limit, post_only, ioc, fok, and stop_limit (omit type and price for a limit at the ticker)

priceRef.description: reference price for percent sizing and brackets

quantity.description: order size: a positive number (contracts/units), or a percent-of-balance string like "50%" (1-100%). Required unless action is set.

resolution.description: chart timeframe TradingView's create_alert needs; defaults to "1" (1 minute)

side.description: order direction; required unless action is set, where it is an optional buy/sell filter for cancel/close (omit for flat)

sizeAgainstEquity.description: for a percent quantity, size against equity instead of available balance (y=equity)

stopLoss.description: attached bracket stop-loss distance from the fill: points (10) or a percent string such as 3%; a sign, if given, must point the right way); pairs with takeProfit or a trail leg

symbol.description: the instrument symbol, e.g. EUR_USD, XBTUSD, BTC_USD

takeProfit.description: attached bracket take-profit distance from the fill: points (20) or a percent string such as 5%; pairs with stopLoss or a trail leg

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

trailActivate.description: points of profit before the trail starts; required whenever trailStop is set

trailFrequency.description: how often the trailing stop re-checks price; defaults to 1 if omitted

trailStop.description: auto-trail stop distance in points; requires trailActivate

trigger.description: absolute trigger (stop) price; required for stop and stop_limit

type.description: order type; defaults to limit at the ticker (t=limit with no price, same as a plain alert). An attached bracket needs type market explicitly.

unit.description: "currency" treats quantity as a CURRENCY amount to convert to units at the resolved price (u=currency) — e.g. quantity:10 with unit:"currency" on BTC/USD buys $10 of BTC instead of 10 BTC. Only meaningful with a fixed (non-percent) quantity.

name: alert
